notes: Fixed: text you typed or edited could be saved as empty boxes. Saved text now uses the fonts Scalpel ships with.
Fixed: lines mixing Hebrew or Arabic with English or numbers saved the English part as boxes.
Fixed: saving an edited line could remove a different, similar line. Only the line you edited is changed now.
Double-click now always picks the whole line, and re-editing a changed line shows your new text, not the old one.
Edited text keeps its colour and position, and editing works on rotated pages.
